title: feat(security): the guest's grants channel, with a share-links-only row scope (ADR-0138 E1, ruling C)
body:
Fixes #23224
Clause-②: yes

ADR-0138 **E1, the grants channel** (D3, D4): the guest entry finds D4's organization, then the `guest` anchor's bindings, and raises the located refusal where D4 refuses. It also applies the maintainer's **ruling C** on #23266 (comment 6148183570): the guest's row scope is **share links only**.

This resumes the released branch (hand-off 6145588579, claim 6146352069). `main` was merged twice. The second merge brought #23056 S8 (PR #23222) and ADR-0138 D2 slice 1. Both `core/security` barrel export sets are kept.

**Landing:** this is a draft. The seat arms it only after the ruling-C pins are on its head (they are, at `1d394b81c3`). The one-sentence ADR-0138 D3 item 6 amendment is a separate Tier H PR from the seat. ⛔ No `docs/adr/**` path is in this diff.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/core`**
  - `resolveAuthzContext`'s anonymous branch takes a new `guestEntry` input. On a face that sets it, the branch reads the sets the `guest` position's definition names, through the same position-bound read every position uses (`positionBoundSetNames`, factored out of the user path). It grants them only in the organization `resolveGuestOrganization` derives.
  - If nothing is bound, no read is issued. With no derived organization, nothing is granted.
  - `resolveGuestOrganization` asks ADR-0131 D9's predicate, `resolveSystemWriteOrganization`. The predicate moved from objectql into core because core cannot import objectql, and D4 item 2 forbids a copy.
  - New module `guest-organization.ts`: `GuestOrganizationUnresolvedError`, which carries `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and `501` from the ADR-0112 catalog, plus `isGuestOrganizationUnresolvedError`.
  - These are new exports. They widen the published index, hence `minor` and `Clause-②: yes`.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`**
  - `tenancy/system-write-organization.ts` re-exports the predicate and its two types from core as the same bindings. Identity is pinned.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`**
  - `resolvePermissionSetsForContextUnmemoized` no longer folds the guest's position into the set request. The guest requests exactly the sets its envelope carries.
  - `resolveOperationPrincipals` calls a new private `refuseGuestWithoutOrganization`, guarded by one new field. A guest that reaches a data operation with no organization, on a deployment where the organization step refuses, gets the located refusal. This happens before any set resolves, and ahead of the prologue's catch-all, which would turn it into a `403`. The operator's log names the reason once per reason.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`** (ruling C)
  - `SharingService.buildReadFilter` answers deny-all for the guest principal, before the sharing-model branch and its owner-less and phantom-anchor fall-throughs. The guest reaches rows only through share links.
  - A link is redeemed at its own door: the share-link routes check the token and `publicSharing.eligibility` and read the one linked record. It never passes through this filter.
  - `externalSharingModel` is still read for no caller (#23268 is its own card).
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**
  - `resolveExecutionContext` passes `guestEntry: true`. This is the one face that takes the explicit guest entry.

ADR-0087 disposition: **none**. No authorable key, accept set or stored shape moves.

**Bindings that start granting on the reference apps: 0.** `app-showcase`, `app-crm` and `app-multi-package` are counted by a dogfood census with a fixture control. `app-todo` declares no positions or sets.

**The seat's answers to the forks, as built:**
- the refusal code is `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`;
- a walled single-organization deployment keeps D9's refusal (D4 item 2);
- no binding door is built here (#23267).

## The record row's pins and their negative controls

| Pin | Where | Negative control / ablation |
|:--|:--|:--|
| No binding: denied on class 4 | dogfood: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, guest identity, no set | The same door admits once a set is bound (the next pin). A1 turns the bound pins red. |
| A bound read set: that object only | dogfood: `200` on the bound object, envelope carries the set and the derived organization, resolved sets exactly that set; `403` on an unbound object. core unit (15 cases) | A1 (anonymous branch ignores `guestEntry`): 2 core pins red |
| Baseline, `everyone` and the name fold never reach the guest | dogfood: a set named like the anchor is `403` for the guest (the admin reads it: `200`); the guest resolves neither the baseline nor `everyone`'s set while a member resolves both. plugin-security unit (3 cases with human controls) | A2 (fold restored): 3 unit pins red. A2d (fold restored, dist rebuilt): 2 door pins red, and the anonymous caller reads the fold object |
| Multi-organization: the located refusal | dogfood: `501`, `error.code` `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, message names the site binding, nothing served. plugin-security unit: `501` for find and insert, with single-org `403` and no-organization-object `403` controls | A3 (gate call removed): the refusal pin red. A4 (grant without D4's organization): 3 core pins red |
| The form doors unchanged | dogfood: single org `201`, row stamped with the organization; two organizations `500 ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED` (the form door's own answer, never the guest refusal) | The class-4 door on the same deployment answers `501` |
| The guest's row scope for each sharing model (**ruling C**) | dogfood: `private`, `public_read`, `public_read` with `externalSharingModel: public_read`, `public_read_write`, a `public_read` parent and its `controlled_by_parent` child. Each is admitted (`200`) and reads **0 rows**; the admin reads more than 0 of each. plugin-sharing unit: deny-all for 5 shapes, with a member control and a system control | A5 (the guard kept referenced but never firing): 4 unit pins red, and 5 door pins red (dist rebuilt). `private` stays 0 under A5 by construction, because the guest was never owner-matched there |
| Share links still serve the guest (ruling C's control) | dogfood: the guest redeems a link and reads the linked record on an object whose rows it otherwise reads none of. Eligibility is held at redemption (the record stops qualifying: `404 INVALID_OR_EXPIRED`) and at the mint (`422 RECORD_NOT_ELIGIBLE`) | n/a |
| The bindings that start granting, counted | dogfood census: 3 reference apps, 0 anchor sets and 0 fold sets | The fixture control counts its own set named like the anchor |

Ablations are one-shot proofs, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. For every leg the anchor hit was 1 and the blob changed. Each restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The door-level legs also ran `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (`--absent` on the mutation, present on the restore, rebuilt each way). No ablation file is kept.

- A1 to A4 were re-run on the final head `1d394b81c3`.
- A2d ran at `df4be9b562`.
- A5 ran at `02caf8afc6`. The read filter is unchanged since then.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` was run on `1d394b81c3` and derived 85 commands. All 85 ran:

- 84 exit 0 in the battery;
- `check:query-options-erasure` exceeded the battery's 400 s timeout and was re-run alone, exit 0.

`--ran` reconciliation: 85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

Four gates went red on the hand-off's files during this round and were fixed here:
- `check-system-context-census`: the guest refusal's redundant system read was removed. Both callers return for a system context first.
- `check:engine-double-contract`: the ledger records the plugin-security unit file's pinned `findOne`, through `--write`, one row.
- `check:slot-lookup`: the dogfood file's engine and security slots are typed.
- `check:where-matcher`: the core unit double refuses a combinator.

## File surface against the claim

- **The claim's files:** as the hand-off measured them.
  - `security-plugin.ts` grew by 4 comment lines, and the guest rule lost its redundant system read.
- **Grown, named:**
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` and its test. This is ruling C's site (`domain:services`), directed by PM comment 6149308636.
  - `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, one ledger row that the gate requires for the hand-off's unit file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bypass-listed objects:** the sharing service's bypass list (`sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `sys_member`, `sys_record_share`, `sys_user_permission_set`) still skips record scoping for every principal, the guest included. This is the platform bypass, not the OWD branch, so ruling C does not reach it.
  - Whether a set bound to `guest` may name one of these objects at all is the anchor tier's question.
  - The tier is checked where a binding is made: the binding-door card #23267.
  - Noted, not filed.
- **Write side:** the write gates (`checkEdit`, `checkDelete`, `buildWriteFilter`) still take the OWD branch for a guest. A guest never reaches them: the guest tier refuses every edit and delete bit (`describeAnchorForbiddenBits`), so a guest update or delete is refused at the object level first. Noted.
- **The form door on a multi-organization deployment** answers its own `500 ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`, as before (D4 item 4 keeps it). It is pinned unchanged here, not altered.
